Scenario fixture: frame-title-attribute-present (RGAA 2.1.1)

Each target has a stable id of the form fta_case_NN. RGAA 2.1.1 asks for a title attribute on every frame; only aria-hidden="true" takes a frame out of scope.

A. No title attribute (FAIL)

01 — FAIL: iframe with no title attribute and no name
02 — FAIL: iframe named by aria-label only
03 — FAIL: iframe removed from the tab order, no title attribute
04 — FAIL: iframe named by aria-labelledby only
Product demo

B. Title attribute present (PASS)

05 — PASS: iframe with a title
06 — PASS: empty title (present; its emptiness is 2.2.1's matter)

C. Out of scope

07 — NOT APPLICABLE: iframe with aria-hidden="true"
08 — NOT APPLICABLE: iframe inside an aria-hidden="true" container
09 — NOT APPLICABLE: iframe hidden with display:none
